hero.filename: USS Radford (DD-446) steaming into Tulagi Harbour with 468 survivors form USS Helena (CL-50) on 6 July 1943.jpg
hero.title: File:USS Radford (DD-446) steaming into Tulagi Harbour with 468 survivors form USS Helena (CL-50) on 6 July 1943.jpg
hero.source: USS Radford (DD-446) steaming into Tulagi Harbour with 468 survivors form USS Helena (CL-50) on 6 July 1943
hero.description: The U.S. Navy destroyer USS Radford (DD-446) steaming into Tulagi Harbour in the Solomons with a deckload of survivors of the sunken light cruiser USS Helena (CL-50), and with the wounded filling all available space below, 6 July 1943. Helena was sunk during the Battle of Kula Gulf the night before. Radford received Presidential Unit Citation for the rescue of 468 survivors.
categories: Battle of Kula Gulf - US forces

gallery.description: Torpedo damage of the U.S. Navy light cruiser USS Helena (CL-50) in the Battle of Kuly Gulf on 6 July 1943. The bow broke off after the first hit. Minutes later two torpedoes hit amidships after which the ship jacknifed.

gallery.description: 80-G-54558:  Battle of the Kula Gulf, July 5-6, 1943.   Funeral service aboard USS Honolulu (CL 48)for Irvin L. gallery.title: File:80-G-54563 (27804049813).jpg
gallery.artist: National Museum of the U.S. Navy
gallery.description: 80-G-54563:  Battle of the Kula Gulf, July 5-6, 1943.  Aboard USS Nicholas (DD 449), survivors of USS Helena (CL 50), which was torpedoed and sunk by the Japanese.  They are debarking at Espiritu Santo, New Hebrides, for a period of relaxation before shipping out for the battlefront again.   Photograph, July 1943.   Official U.S. Navy photograph, now in the collections of the National Archives.   (2016/07/19).

gallery.description: 80-G-54565:  Battle of the Kula Gulf, July 5-6, 1943.  Files of empty shell cases are loaded on a barge from a U.S. Navy warship which used them in the Battle of the Kula Gulf.     Photograph, August 17, 1943.   Official U.S. Navy photograph, now in the collections of the National Archives.   (2016/07/19).

gallery.title: File:80-G-43403 (33134229196).jpg
gallery.artist: National Museum of the U.S. Navy
gallery.description: 80-G-43403: Lieutenant Commander Warren C. Boles, USNR, who, after USS Helena (CL 50) was sunk in the Battle of Kula Gulf, helped to inspire a group of more than 50 survivors and lead them to Vella Lavella Island from which they were rescued.   Received September 20, 1943.    U.S. Navy photograph, now in the collections of the National Archives.  (2017/02/28).
